name: Advance Home Renovations LLC
what_they_do: Home renovation and remodeling contractor listed as a general contractor at 47 Welton St Apt 2A. Its only domain, advancehomereno.com, is advertised on its Google profile but no longer resolves, so nothing online describes its services beyond Google's category and a 'LGBTQ+ friendly' attribute.
customers: Homeowners (inference from category and listing type); no customer-facing content available.

size_signals.signal: Google profile: 5.0, category General contractor, phone (973) 905-2129, website field points to advancehomereno.com, no photos, hours from 8am
advancehonereno.com-style domain in the profile fails DNS ('Name or service not known'), so the GBP website link is a dead end (verified by direct fetch of http://www.advancehomereno.com/)
BuildZoom (via search result) reports the NJ home-improvement registration as inactive and could not verify an active licence

listing.reviews: count hidden in Maps limited view; no reviews seen on any aggregator

website_review.out_of_date_signs: Website is listed on Google but the domain has lapsed — every click from Maps lands on an error page
website_review.search_basics: Nothing indexable; no titles, no services, no town pages
top_issues: Dead website advertised on the Google profile — the highest-intent click the business gets goes nowhere
Google profile has no photos and no description
No way to request a quote online
Licence/registration reportedly inactive, which must be resolved before any marketing spend

agent_readiness.notes: Findable 1: a GBP exists with phone and category, but its website link is broken and there are no photos. Answerable 0: no readable services, hours, area or prices anywhere. Bookable 0: no form or booking of any kind.

operations_signals.signal: All enquiries depend on one mobile number; there is no intake or job record online (inference from the total absence of web presence)
Listing address is an apartment (Apt 2A), consistent with a very small owner-operator outfit (inference)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Restore the website (new domain or re-register the old one) and point the Google profile at a working page with services, service area, hours and a labelled quote form
top_opportunities.evidence: advancehomereno.com fails DNS while Google still links to it

top_opportunities.opportunity: Upload project photos and a business description to Google, and start collecting reviews (the profile is 5.0 but effectively unproven)
top_opportunities.evidence: Maps shows 'Add photos & videos' prompts and no review count

top_opportunities.opportunity: Set up a missed-call text-back and a simple intake form so enquiries do not evaporate while on site
top_opportunities.evidence: No online intake exists at all

scores.reasons: Gap 5: no working site, no content, dead link on Google. Ability 1: apartment-based owner-operator, reported inactive registration — little budget and a licensing question to settle first. Ease 5: a rebuild is simple. Evidence 4: Maps profile and DNS failure both verified directly; licensing only via a third-party directory.
